import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    if not line:
        return
    
    parts = line.split()
    numbers = [int(x) for x in parts]
    
    total = sum(numbers)
    max_val = max(numbers)
    min_val = min(numbers)
    avg = total / len(numbers)
    
    print(total)
    print(f"{max_val} {min_val}")
    print(f"{avg:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
